set system host-name [parameter1].explanation: Configure the host name of the device.

parameters.name: hostname
parameters.explanation: The host name of the equipment is used to identify the equipment in the network.

parameters.name: ssm-control
parameters.explanation: The SSM control state, "on" indicates that it is enabled.

set system clock bits-type [parameter1].explanation: The command configures the BITS (Building Integrated Timing Supply) interface type and rate.

parameters.name: bits-interface
parameters.explanation: BITS interface name, for example, bits0.

parameters.name: rate
parameters.explanation: The rate of the BITS interface, for example, 2 Mbps.

set system clock source [parameter1].explanation: Configure the source of the system clock.

parameters.name: source
parameters.explanation: Source of system clocks, for example, ptp.

synchronization [parameter2].explanation: The `synchronization [parameter2]` command in Junos enables or configures synchronization settings for routing protocols, ensuring consistent routing information across devices.

parameters.name: synchronization
parameters.explanation: The command explanation translates to: "Synchronization function status, 'enable' means to activate."

priority [parameter2].explanation: The command `priority [parameter2]` sets the priority level for a routing protocol or interface, influencing its selection in routing decisions.

parameters.name: priority
parameters.explanation: The priority of the clock source; the smaller the value, the higher the priority.

unit [parameter2].explanation: Configure the unit number of the interface.

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: Interface unit numbers that distinguish between multiple logical configurations under the same interface.

clock synchronization [parameter3].explanation: The command `clock synchronization [parameter3]` configures the device to synchronize its system clock using the specified synchronization method or protocol defined by `[parameter3]`.

parameters.name: synchronization
parameters.explanation: The command explanation is: "Synchronization function status, 'enable' means to activate."

clock priority [parameter3].explanation: The command `clock priority [parameter3]` sets the priority value for a clock source in Junos, influencing its selection in a network time synchronization protocol like PTP.

parameters.name: priority
parameters.explanation: The priority of the clock, the smaller the value, the higher the priority.
